args.code:
import numpy as np

# Load the file from files list (injected into sandbox)
data = files[0]["table"]
raman_shift = data["raman_shift_cm-1"]
intensity = data["intensity"]

# Calculate L2 norm
l2_norm = np.linalg.norm(intensity)
print(f"Original L2 norm: {l2_norm}")

# Normalize
normalized_intensity = intensity / l2_norm
final_norm = np.linalg.norm(normalized_intensity)
print(f"Normalized L2 norm: {final_norm}")

# Save result
saved_path = save_result("T056_normalized", normalized_intensity, raman_shift=raman_shift)
print(f"Saved to: {saved_path}")
